changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: An issue type gets its own key. The provider's id moves to native_id, which is unique per organization: GitLab's system-defined work item types have the same global id on every instance. Issues whose repository is on another provider instance than their type get a copy of that type in the root group of their own instance. The keys change type in place, so no column moves. The previous server cannot read the new keys: this change needs a stopped window.

rollback.stop: Issue type keys cannot go back to provider ids, because two organizations can now hold the same provider id. Restore the database backup from before this upgrade.
